svg.title: UART frame format
svg.desc: Animated waveform of one UART frame: idle, start bit, eight data bits LSB first, optional parity, one or two stop bits. A cursor sweeps across while receive sample points light up and the received byte 0xA5 is assembled.
svg.text: UART FRAME · 8-E-2 shown (worst case, 12 bits) · data byte 0xA5

g.text: rx_data[7:0] = 0xA5 · parity (EVEN) OK · stop bits OK → pushed into RX FIFO

svg.text: Every bit lasts CLKS_PER_BIT = BAUD_DIV clock cycles (reset default 434 → 8.68 µs at 50 MHz).
RX validates the start bit at half-bit, then samples each field at its centre. Parity mode and stop-bit count come from FRAME_CONFIG and are latched at each frame start.
